1. ScrapingBee – Best overall value for developers

- Clean, consistent JSON responses
- Built-in proxy rotation and CAPTCHA handling

- Competitive pricing with clear usage limits and no hidden fees

2. SerpApi – Feature-rich and developer-friendly

- Supports Google, Bing, Yahoo, DuckDuckGo, Yandex, and Naver
- Real-time API calls produce structured JSON, covering organic results, featured snippets, maps, and shopping data
- LLM integration possible for AI workflows

3. Oxylabs – Enterprise-grade solution

- High-volume search scraping with ML-powered infrastructure
- Handles CAPTCHA, proxy rotation, and city-level geotargeting
- Ideal for large-scale SEO tracking and complex enterprise requirements
- Free trial available, with pricing starting around $1–$1.15 per 1,000 results depending on the engine. 4. Bright Data – High-performance and scalable

- Real-time results from Google, Bing, DuckDuckGo, Yahoo, Yandex, Naver, Baidu, and more
- Supports maps, news, shopping searches, with precise geo-targeting to 195+ countries
- Fast response times (~1 second on average) and pay-for-success pricing
- Excellent for AI agent integration, web apps, or enterprise SEO pipelines. Excellent for AI agent integration, web apps, or enterprise SEO pipelines [2](https://brightdata.com/blog/web-data/best-serp-apis)

5. Decodo – Flexible multi-format scraping

- Returns JSON, CSV, Markdown, HTML, PNG, and XHR output
- Includes proxy rotation, CAPTCHA solving, and geo-targeting
- Supports Google, Bing, Yahoo, Baidu
- 100+ pre-built templates for automated workflows
